text:
joel: Heads-up: Delta Foods wants a 4-week sealed-site POC. Requirements: strictly air-gapped (no egress), physical media only, prefer customer HSM (YubiHSM2 or Luna), quarterly patch windows, signed SBOMs, and a chain-of-custody for bundles. Ask: can we support offline activation, operator signing, and courier workflow?
anya: Yes - offline activation and sneakernet are supported. Key patterns: customer-sign (recommended) or Redwood-pre-sign. Need to know HSM model and whether operator workstation is available inside the perimeter.
diego: Runtime notes: userland PKCS#11 integration works for both YubiHSM and Luna. If kernel modules blocked we run a user-space signer that calls the PKCS#11 lib. We can verify detached signatures during install.
joel: They will bring their HSM and operator workstation. Also asked about patch cadence: they only permit quarterly windows but expect emergency hotfixes via courier.
anya: For emergency hotfixes we require an approved pre-signed hotfix flow and an operator acceptance checklist. We can aim for manual apply <60m for POC if compressed delta <1GB.
diego: Bundle sizes: quantized deltas ~100-500MB; full unquantized bundles can be 5-20GB. Recommend quantized artifacts for courier efficiency.
ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-8701: "Delta Foods sealed-site POC - physical media & HSM flow" assigned to @diego. https://redwood.example/tickets/RDW-8701
anja: Security: telemetry disabled, local audit logs only, signed SBOM and provenance provided. For FIPS: we can provide FIPS-enabled builds for TLS/signing if they confirm scope.
joel: Next steps: diego to produce sample manifest+sig-request and a short operator runbook; anya to start SQ answers; I'll schedule a 30m presales call tomorrow 11am PT.
anya: I'll attach the partial SQ answers and sample acceptance criteria to RDW-8701 by EOD.
diego: I'll post the lab verification notes and a sample sig-request in the ticket.
joel: Thanks all — I'll update the customer after the call. :rocket:
